units.name: Department of Information Systems and Business Analytics
units.evidence: The current official department explicitly teaches Operations Management at undergraduate, graduate and PhD levels. Its Business Administration PhD/Information Systems programme page explicitly lists Operations Research applications in IT management and Supply Chain Management research.

units.name: Department of Marketing and Logistics
units.evidence: The official department mission explicitly includes logistics teaching and research. It hosts the PayCargo Supply Chain and Logistics Program and describes international logistics and SCM provision.

units.name: Multidisciplinary Engineering and Computing Education, Systems and Management Department
units.evidence: The exact official department describes logistics and supply-chain optimization and lists Engineering Management and Logistics Engineering masters degrees. Its separate PhD is Engineering and Computing Education; this is not converted into a Logistics PhD.

units.name: Department of Civil & Environmental Engineering
units.evidence: The official department research page links LCTR, whose opened education and research pages establish graduate transportation systems planning, traffic operations, demand modelling, simulation and public transportation research. The department explicitly offers the Civil PhD with Transportation Engineering specialization.

decisions.reason: The current official Information Systems unit is the expanded Department of Information Systems and Business Analytics. This maps the imported subject label to the current unit without inferring a dated historic job identity or rename.

Current official name is Department of Information Systems and Business Analytics, College of Business, but the imported DSIS faculty link is now an official404. No opened evidence establishes formal succession or rename date for the older Decision Sciences and Information Systems label.
